pr_title: Json parsing exceptions should not cause 500 errors
pr_body:
Currently we wrap JsonEOFException from advancing the json parser into our own XContentEOFException, but this has the drawback that is results in 500 errors on the client side. Instead this should be 400 errors. We should throw XContentParseException instead like we e.g. already to in the "nextFieldName" method or elsewhere in JsonXContentParser.

Closes #111542
pr_comments: tagging @elastic/es-core-infra for awareness and since you own general xcontent issues, but we found this while looking into 500s from the "_search" endpoint, so also tagging search foundations.
Hi @cbuescher, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

I ended up removing the whole XContentEOFException, the only place we differentiate based on the cause of an XContentParseException seems to be the warning in the BulkRequestParser that is going to be removed anyway.

issue_context.title: Malformed Json can lead to 500 errors
issue_context.body:
### Elasticsearch Version

8.14.3

### Installed Plugins

_No response_

### Java Version

_bundled_

### OS Version

Darwin 22.6.0 Darwin Kernel Version 22.6.0: Mon Jun 24 01:22:14 PDT 2024; root:xnu-8796.141.3.706.2~1/RELEASE_ARM64_T6000 arm64 

### Problem Description

When I send incomplete Json request bodies (like `{` ) to ES, it bubbles up the resulting JsonEOFException as an XContentEOFException and I get a 500 error on the client side. I believe this should be a 400 instead.

### Steps to Reproduce

Install ES 8.14.3 locally,

```
curl localhost:9200/_search -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{'
```

Response:

```
{
    "error": {
        "root_cause": [
            {
                "type": "x_content_e_o_f_exception",
                "reason": "com.fasterxml.jackson.core.io.JsonEOFException: Unexpected end-of-input: expected close marker for Object (start marker at [Source: (byte[])\"{\"; line: 1, column: 1])\n at [Source: (byte[])\"{\"; line: 1, column: 2]"
            }
        ],
        "type": "x_content_e_o_f_exception",
        "reason": "com.fasterxml.jackson.core.io.JsonEOFException: Unexpected end-of-input: expected close marker for Object (start marker at [Source: (byte[])\"{\"; line: 1, column: 1])\n at [Source: (byte[])\"{\"; line: 1, column: 2]",
        "caused_by": {
            "type": "json_e_o_f_exception",
            "reason": "Unexpected end-of-input: expected close marker for Object (start marker at [Source: (byte[])\"{\"; line: 1, column: 1])\n at [Source: (byte[])\"{\"; line: 1, column: 2]"
        }
    },
    "status": 500
}
```

### Logs (if relevant)

[2024-08-02T11:54:38,145][WARN ][r.suppressed             ] [xxx] path: /_search, params: {}, status: 500org.elasticsearch.xcontent.XContentEOFException: com.fasterxml.jackson.core.io.JsonEOFException: Unexpected end-of-input: expected close marker for Object (start marker at [Source: (byte[])"{"; line: 1, column: 1])
 at [Source: (byte[])"{"; line: 1, column: 2]
	at org.elasticsearch.xcontent.impl@8.14.3/org.elasticsearch.xcontent.provider.json.JsonXContentParser.nextToken(JsonXContentParser.java:60)
	at org.elasticsearch.server@8.14.3/org.elasticsearch.search.builder.SearchSourceBuilder.parseXContent(SearchSourceBuilder.java:1298)
	at org.elasticsearch.server@8.14.3/org.elasticsearch.search.builder.SearchSourceBuilder.parseXContent(SearchSourceBuilder.java:1259)
	at org.elasticsearch.server@8.14.3/org.elasticsearch.rest.action.search.RestSearchAction.parseSearchRequest(RestSearchAction.java:181)
	at org.elasticsearch.server@8.14.3/org.elasticsearch.rest.action.search.RestSearchAction.lambda$prepareRequest$1(RestSearchAction.java:120)

review_comments: I do not think we should stop catching JsonEOFException. Rather, I think we should adjust the wrapper exception to exhibit the desired behavior when interacting with xcontent. One way to do so could be to change XContentEOFException to extend XContentParseException (which extends from IllegalArgumentException, and that translates to a 400).
